title: The roadmap's in-progress check sees every live lane
why: Owner, Nov 2 00:00 CST: the roadmap and the live work must stay in step.
note:
Measured Nov 1 18:08 CST, first build with the live file (triage had published without one, so the check read unknown): 18 in-progress steps flagged, most of them false. Causes: (1) 15 lane sessions carry the short repo tag claude-settings, but the check wants the full GitHub name; (2) roll-out lanes run in another repo carry that repo's tag, so claude-settings steps r5, r2, r4 and o3 never match; (3) a lane tagged with another step id (one-model-rule's lane carries explore-audit-marker). Fix: one tag form at session start (the coordinator's create step), a roll-out lane also carries this roadmap's tag, and triage publishes with the live file every time. Guard basis: measured. Ready: no open question.
Doing, Nov 1 18:03 CST: coordinator started its lane.
Lane, Nov 1 18:05 CST: new guard rule lane-repo-tag needs a lane's tags to hold cs-repo:<the calling checkout's owner/name>; it fixes causes 1 and 2. Cause 3 (a wrong cs-step tag) is not fixed by it; the lane files it as a note.
